Compliance check before postingMASA: no scheduled condition is named in the video or any copy (no #Diabetes). Copy says "blood sugar check" and everyday habits, with no promise to treat or prevent anything. Google Business: no phone numbers, links or hashtags in the post text (use the Call now / Learn more button), no medicine promotion, square image with little text. Confirm the check's price or promo with the outlet before adding it.
